structuredAnswers.situationSummary: I'm a single parent with two kids. My hours at work got cut this month and I'm trying to plan ahead so we don't fall behind on groceries. I heard about food pantry resources and wanted to learn more.

screeningComments.general: Just looking for a steady food pantry option so we can stretch our budget.

transcript.content: Hi! I'm an AI intake assistant — a human case manager will review what we collect. Ready to start?
Thanks Maria. A Hope Connector will follow up with food pantry options.

qaPairs.question: How would you like us to reach you?
What kind of help do you need?
Is this urgent or are you planning ahead?
qaPairs.answer: Planning ahead, not urgent right now.

qaPairs.question: Tell me about your situation in your own words.
qaPairs.answer: Single parent, hours got cut, want to plan ahead for groceries.

summary.staff_facing: Client is a single parent of two children who reports reduced work hours this month and a tighter household food budget. She is asking about local food pantry options ahead of next month's grocery cycle. No urgency, no risk flags; situation is stable. Pair the pantry referral with a SNAP screening to address underlying budget pressure.
summary.client_facing: Thanks Maria — a Hope Connector will reach out by phone to share food pantry options near you and walk through SNAP eligibility if that would help.

severity.rationale: Client is stable and planning ahead — a routine food assistance inquiry with no immediate risk indicators.

follow_up_questions: Confirm Maria's preferred pantry day-of-week and time-of-day for follow-up.
